signUp.heroDescription: Join Virexa and get access to the latest AI, technology and gaming news with smart summaries tailored for you.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your Virexa experience.

general.contentDescription: Pick the topics you want to see more of across Virexa.
general.countryErrorToast: Couldn't save your country. Please try again.

reading.openLinksLabel: Open source links in new tab
reading.openLinksDescription: Links to a release's website, docs, or GitHub repo open in a new tab.
reading.progressBarDescription: Saved preference only - a progress indicator isn't shown on articles yet.
reading.rememberScrollDescription: Saved preference only - articles don't yet resume from where you left off.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDescription: Applies instantly on the Navbar, Profile, Bookmarks and Settings pages.
appearance.readingWidthDescription: Saved preference only - article layout doesn't change with this yet.
appearance.readingWidthComfortableDescription: Wider article column, more breathing room.
appearance.readingWidthCompactDescription: Narrower column for a denser reading view.
appearance.themeErrorToast: Couldn't save your theme. Please try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.breakingNewsDescription: Urgent, high-impact stories as they happen.
notifications.releaseDescription: New framework and tool releases you follow.
notifications.hubUpdatesDescription: New guides, tools and resources added to the Developer Hub.
notifications.bookmarkRemindersDescription: Occasional nudges about bookmarked articles you haven't read yet.
notifications.dailyDigestDescription: One roundup of the day's top stories.
notifications.weeklyDigestDescription: A recap of the week's most-read stories.
notifications.emailDescription: Allow Virexa to email you at all.

privacy.prefsDescription: Control what Virexa tracks and shows about your account. Saves immediately.
privacy.visibilityDescription: Whether other signed-in users can see your public profile page.
privacy.analyticsDescription: Allow Virexa to collect anonymous usage analytics to improve the product.
privacy.recommendationsDescription: Use your reading activity to personalize recommended articles.
privacy.searchHistoryDescription: Keep a record of what you search for on Virexa.
privacy.readingHistoryDescription: Keep a record of the articles you open.
privacy.dataDescription: Manage the data Virexa has saved for your account.

privacy.clearBookmarksDescription: Remove every saved article, release and repository bookmark.
privacy.exportDescription: Download your profile, settings, bookmarks and reading history as a JSON file.
